body:
# TrashBin Plugin – Description

TrashBin is a lightweight and simple Minecraft plugin that adds a virtual trash GUI to your server. Players can quickly delete unwanted items without cluttering their inventory or the world.

With a clean and modern design, TrashBin helps keep your server organized and improves overall gameplay quality.

---

## Features

- Open a trash GUI with `/trash`
- Instantly delete unwanted items
- Sound effect when closing the inventory
- Customizable GUI title via `config.yml`
- Fully English and international-ready
- Lightweight and performance friendly

---

## Configuration

TrashBin includes a simple configuration file:

- Change the GUI title
- Change the close sound

No coding required — everything is editable in `config.yml`.

---

## Usage

Simply type:

```text
/trash
```
